items.title: M-Files Vulnerability Let Attacker Capture Session Tokens of Other Active Users
items.description: An information disclosure vulnerability in M-Files Server enables authenticated attackers to capture and reuse session tokens from active users. Potentially gaining unauthorized access to sensitive document management systems. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2025-13008, affects multiple versions across different release branches and carries a high-severity CVSS 4.0 base score of 8.6. The vulnerability…
